home.showcaseAppPrompt: Please build a reading tracker for me. Let me add books and record reading progress, ratings, and notes, set a yearly reading goal (such as 50 books), and see how much I have finished. Show a dashboard with a yearly progress bar, reading volume by genre, a monthly reading trend, and a few plain-language insights, for example "You have read 23 books this year, 3 ahead of the yearly goal, and novels make up 58% of your reading." Support CSV import and export. Store the data in the browser.
home.showcaseImagePrompt: An athlete sprints at full effort down a rainy night street, in a dynamic side medium shot that clearly shows the head, ear, upper body, and running posture. A pair of pearl-white wireless sport earbuds sits naturally on the ear, with a translucent silicone wing fitted to the ear; the product is clearly visible at a true-to-life size. The athlete's foot strikes standing water and throws up a splash, and the wet pavement reflects electric lime and cool cyan neon. Deep indigo night, cold cinematic light, a few lime-colored motes of dust, with the energy of a premium sports-technology advertisement.
